desc: Implement the inclusion-exclusion residue-class solution in Python with stdin/stdout handling.
Use dense arrays for small moduli and dictionaries for large moduli to keep residue aggregation fast.
Validate sample tests and edge cases such as N=1, all odd values, powers of two, and maximum constraints.
If the implementation fails or is too slow, switch to the exact-valuation residue method or a hybrid sorted-interval fallback.
